info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Securities Fails Processing Reviews API
info.description: The Securities Fails Processing Reviews API enables financial institutions to submit and manage reviews related to securities fails operations. This endpoint is essential for ensuring compliance and accuracy in the handling of failed securities transactions. Users, including compliance teams and operational staff, can leverage this API to input reviews, track issues, and enhance transaction oversight. The service aims to optimize the securities processing workflow, fostering transparency and efficiency in trade settlement operations.

post.summary: Create a review for a securities fail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific securities fail identified by its unique reference ID. The review will be processed and associated with the securities fail for future reference.
